title: Predictive audio representations for early detection and tracking of hidden dynamic objects
abstract: arXiv:2609.13595v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting potential dangers is core to safety. Forecasting the presence of other traffic agents is core to danger prediction. Occluded traffic agents challenge detection systems as they might become visible too late, leaving the autonomous vehicle too little time to identify, plan and act accordingly in a robust and safe way. Previous works proved that auditory perception, being omnidirectional and not constrained by a field-of-view, provides fundamental cues for early spotting of different road users, even when hidden by other vehicles or infrastructures. Yet, those contributions deal with scenarios with only one vehicle present, and they either identify the type of vehicle or estimate its direction of arrival. In this work, we move forward, and propose a multi-task system which, simultaneously, estimates the number of vehicles present, their type, and their direction of arrival. translated_title: 用于隐藏动态物体早期检测与跟踪的预测性音频表示
translated_abstract: 预测潜在危险是安全的核心，而预测其他交通参与者的存在则是危险预测的核心。被遮挡的交通参与者对检测系统构成了挑战，因为它们可能过晚才进入视野，使自动驾驶汽车没有足够的时间以稳健且安全的方式进行识别、规划和行动。先前的研究已经证明，听觉感知具有全方位性且不受视场限制，能够为早期发现不同道路使用者提供关键线索，即使这些道路使用者被其他车辆或基础设施遮挡。然而，这些已有工作仅处理只有一辆车存在的场景，且要么识别车辆类型，要么估计其到达方向。在本工作中，我们更进一步，提出了一个多任务系统，能够同时估计在场车辆的数量、类型以及它们的到达方向。我们的方法学贡献是一个两阶段流水线（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于预测性音频表示的多任务两阶段系统，能够同时估计被遮挡车辆的数量、类型和到达方向，从而实现隐藏动态物体的早期检测与跟踪。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage multi-task system based on predictive audio representations that simultaneously estimates the number, type, and direction of arrival of occluded vehicles, enabling early detection and tracking of hidden dynamic objects.
